observations: Three photos show two large car engines side by side in a cluttered workshop or garage.
The engine on the left has a silver valve cover with 'PORSCHE' visible on the side.
The engine on the right has a black valve cover with 'PORSCHE' and '1.6' visible on the side.
The central part of both engines has a black intake manifold with red markings, possibly 'F13' or similar, but not clearly legible.
The engines appear to be used, with visible grime, oil residue, and some wear.
The surrounding area is messy, with debris and other parts stacked above the engines.
No visible damage to the engines themselves, but no clear view of the cylinder head, block, or internal components.
No visible model numbers or VINs on the engines.
The watermark 'EZE PORSCHE GLOBAL AUTOS' is present on all photos, suggesting a seller or brand name, not a genuine Porsche.
